Aiya, let me think about this year's peanut...

I've been farming this little patch of 4.1 mu for more than fifty years now. Just me and the old lady at home — the kids are grown and working in town, they don't help much except at harvest if I call them. So whatever I plant, the two of us have to handle it ourselves, and my back isn't what it used to be.

Peanut has been good to me. This land is a bit sandy, not great for wheat anyway, and peanut likes sandy soil. Same thing I planted last year and the year before. Why change? Last year I got maybe 300-some kg per mu shelled, not bad, not great. Price was around 5 yuan a jin, so I made some money after paying for everything.

**Seed** — I saved some from last year like I always do, the local big-grain variety (大花生) that grows well here. My neighbor old Wang said the new variety from the seed shop gives more, but it costs 8-9 yuan a jin and I'd need to buy maybe 15-16 jin per mu. That's over a hundred yuan per mu just for seed, plus I don't know if it'll do well on my plot. I'll stick with my own seed, maybe buy a little to mix in so it doesn't get too tired.

**Planting** — Late April, beginning of May (谷雨 to 立夏). Wait for the soil to warm up enough that you can sit on it without feeling cold. If you plant too early it just rots. I do the plastic mulch (地膜) — everyone here does, keeps the soil warm and you get higher yield. The film costs money but it's worth it. My son-in-law's nephew has a small mulch-planting machine, I pay him 40-50 yuan per mu and he does it in a morning.

**Fertilizer** — I use the compound fertilizer, the 15-15-15 kind. One big bag is 40 kg, and for 4.1 mu I'll buy maybe 4 bags, so about 40 kg per mu. Put it all down when I plough. Peanut doesn't need so much nitrogen — it makes its own somehow, people say the roots do it. Last year I also put a bit of 过磷酸钙 (superphosphate) because someone at the village said peanut likes phosphorus, maybe 20 kg per mu. I'll do the same. And a bag of 石膏 (gypsum) sprinkled when the pegs go down — my grandfather used to do this, makes the pods fill better. Total maybe 150-170 yuan per mu on fertilizer.

**Irrigation** — I have the well, but pumping costs electricity. Peanut doesn't need as much water as maize. If spring is very dry I'll water once before planting to get it up, then once more when the pods are filling in August if the rain doesn't come. Two times usually. Maybe three if it's a bad drought year. Each time costs me 15-20 yuan per mu in electricity.

**Pests and weeds** — I spray one herbicide right after I lay the film, before the seedlings come up, cheap stuff the agri shop sells. Then in summer if I see the aphids or the leaf spot, I'll buy a small bottle of something and spray once with the backpack sprayer. My wife doesn't like me doing this at my age but she can't manage the sprayer. Usually 30-40 yuan per mu for all the spraying.

**Tillage** — Old man Liu in the village has a small tractor, he comes and ploughs and rotovates for me, 60 yuan per mu. I can't do it myself anymore. Then I hand-spread the fertilizer before he comes through the second time.

**Labor** — Me and my wife. We do the weeding by hand where the herbicide missed, we do the harvesting with a small puller my son bought me. At harvest time if the kids can come back from town for two days we get through it faster. I don't hire anyone, can't afford to and don't need to on 4.1 mu.

**Yield** — If the weather is normal, I expect about 300 kg per mu shelled, maybe 320 if I'm lucky. Last year was okay. If it's too dry in August or if it rains at harvest, could drop to 250. My neighbor down the row gets 350+ but he uses the new variety and more fertilizer. Good for him, but I know what I know.
